resources.string: Sharing your location while the app is open or in the background.
App closed and tracking stopped from notification
Background tracking will stop when you leave the app until notification permission is granted and Active race tracking notifications are enabled. Tracking can continue while the app is open.
Battery Saver pauses GPS with the screen off

This phone disables GPS when Battery Saver is on and the screen is off. Turn Battery Saver off for continuous background tracking. Unrestricted app battery use and Wake lock do not override this setting.
Closing the app stops recording your location.
Precise location permission is required for tracking.
